description: This file defines a script for generating and sending password reset links or new passwords to users in a CRM system, with logic for retrieving user data, validating inputs, generating URLs, and emailing users.

classes.name: user
classes.description: Class representing a user in the CRM system, with methods for retrieving user data and sending password emails.

methods.name: sendEmailForPassword
methods.description: Method used to send password or reset link emails to users.

methods.name: retrieve_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves a user's ID based on username.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Loads user data based on user ID.

methods.name: isPrimaryEmail
methods.description: Checks if an email address is the user's primary email.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Returns a hash of the password or key.
